metadata.title: Reduced-resolution filter
metadata.description: Counteracts blur when the game renders at a reduced resolution (e.g. Sodium Extra's 'Reduce Resolution on macOS'). Only takes effect when the display is upscaling a reduced framebuffer. 'Sharpen' softly crisps the whole menu; 'Harden edges' aliases text/edges so they survive the upscale like Minecraft's font (crisper text, but blockier corners).

metadata.title: Search index
metadata.description: The state of the embedding model and the search index.

metadata.title: Maximum Results
metadata.description: The maximum amount of search results

metadata.title: Maximum Lexical Results
metadata.description: Amount of results the lexical search pulls before fusion

metadata.title: Lexical Title Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search if the match is found in the title

metadata.title: Lexical Mod Name Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search if the match is found in the name of the mod the option belongs to

metadata.title: Lexical Category Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search if the match is found in the option's category, subcategory or page

metadata.title: Lexical Tag Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search if the match is found in the option's tags

metadata.title: Lexical Field Agreement
metadata.description: How much a word matching in several fields at once counts for. At 0 a word is scored against whichever field suits it best, so matching in the title, the mod name and the category is worth no more than matching in the title alone.

metadata.title: Lexical Exact Match Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search if there is an exact match. Below 1 because the fuzzy and prefix matches already score the exact word too, so it would otherwise be counted several times over.

metadata.title: Lexical Phrase Boost
metadata.description: Boost in lexical search when the searched words appear together, in order, rather than scattered across the option

metadata.title: Lexical Phrase Slop
metadata.description: How many words may sit between the searched words and still count as a phrase

metadata.title: Minimum Length for Fuzzy Search
metadata.description: Minimum length of the search query before fuzzy search is used, shorter queries will surface a lot of junk with fuzzy search.

metadata.title: Fuzzy Search Fixed Prefix
metadata.description: How many leading characters a fuzzy match must get right. Raising it makes fuzzy search cheaper but gives up on typos in the first characters, such as MC-268617 typed as MC-628617.

metadata.title: Maximum Semantic Results
metadata.description: Amount of results the semantic (KNN) vector search pulls before fusion.

metadata.title: Minimum Semantic Score
metadata.description: The minimum score for semantic (KNN) vector search results.

metadata.title: Words before weight scaling starts
metadata.description: The amount of words needed before the weight scaling of semantic results start.

metadata.title: Words for maximum semantic weight
metadata.description: The weight of the semantic search depends on the length of the search query, this option decides the amount of words before the maximum weight is reached.

metadata.title: Minimum Semantic Weight
metadata.description: The weight attached to semantic search results for a short query.

metadata.title: Maximum Semantic Weight
metadata.description: The weight attached to semantic search results for a long query.

metadata.title: Export Search Documents
metadata.description: Export all currently loaded search documents, useful for benchmarking.

When playing on high render distance, quitting the world can still take a bit because the client-side chunk storage has to be cleared.
By enabling this setting the "Saving world" screen will be rendered.

metadata.title: Background Thread Priority
metadata.description:
Sets the thread priority of the server when saving worlds in the background.
This is done to improve client performance while saving, but will make the saving take longer over all.

metadata.title: Allow multiple running Worlds
metadata.description:
When this option is enabled, you can join a new world while the old one is still saving.
This is safe to do in vanilla Minecraft, but some mods may have issues when 2 servers run at the same time.

Ixeris

metadata.title: Default signing mode
metadata.description:
Sets the signing mode default for servers that
force or allow chat signing.
§b§l§nNever§r
§b§l§n§rIn this mode, messages are never signed and all
§b§l§n§rserver requests to sign them are ignored.
§b§l§n§r
§b§l§n§r§b§l§nAlways§r
§b§l§n§rThis mode automatically enables message signing
§b§l§n§ras soon as you enter the server, identically to
§b§l§n§rhow a vanilla client would.
§b§l§n§r
§b§l§n§r§b§l§nPrompt§r
§b§l§n§rIn this mode, messages are not signed by default,
§b§l§n§rbut if the server demands signing, you will be
§b§l§n§rshown a pop-up screen where you can enable
§b§l§n§rsigning for one session.
§b§l§n§r
§b§l§n§r§b§l§nOn Demand§r
§b§l§n§rSimilar to prompt mode, but instead of showing a
§b§l§n§rpop-up screen, signing will just be enabled
§b§l§n§rautomatically as soon as the server demands it.
